notes.title: Keep on Mining! is finally out! + Bundle announcements!
notes.content:
After an unfortunate 2 week delay, Keep on Mining! is finally out and ready to be played! Thank you so much for your patience, the game has garnered a lot of hype so it's great that is it finally out!

The game will have a 15% discount for 1 week. The game is also part of a lot of bundles. This will make the game even cheaper if you own some of the games inside these bundles.

[b]Game:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/3769130/Keep_on_Mining/

[b]Bundles:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56924/Astro_Prospector_X_Keep_on_Mining/]Astro Prospector X Keep on Mining! [/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56924/Astro_Prospector_X_Keep_on_Mining/]Minutescape X Keep on Mining![/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56702/Keep_on_Mining__Support_pack_DLC/]Support pack DLC bundle [/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/32106/EagleEye_Game_Collection/]EagleEye Games collection bundle[/url]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43674917/294582634c05466352cc2d4d7f56ba3ec04a25f6.png[/img]

It's time to go mining!
